item.title: In First Human Trial, Zombie Cancer Cells Train the Body to Fight Tumors
item.description: Shelly Fan in Singularity Hub: Lights, vitamin, action. A combination of vitamin B2 and ultraviolet light hardly sounds like a next-generation cancer treatment. But a small new trial is testing the duo in people with recurrent ovarian cancer. Led by PhotonPharma, this first-in-humans study builds on decades of work investigating whether we can turn whole cancer cells into “vaccines.”…
